## About

Henry Vu is a machine learning engineer at eXRealityAI in Dallas, and is finishing an M.Sc. in Computer Science at UT Dallas,
expected Summer 2027. Before that he did a B.Sc. Honors in Computing Science at the University
of Alberta, graduating summa cum laude.

At eXReality he builds XR Auto Service and Smart DVI, a spatial AI platform for auto shops. It
puts an agent on a technician's headset that guides them through a repair or an inspection and
answers questions from a repair knowledge graph. He leads engineering on Smart DVI and owns its
AI layer, and he shipped GardenXR to the Meta Horizon Store. On the research side, he works with
Dr. Katherine Brown at UT Dallas on NIH-funded ultrasound segmentation, making models small and
robust enough for portable devices.

## Where he has worked

- Machine Learning Engineer, eXRealityAI, Dallas, Aug 2025 to now. Lead engineer on Smart DVI, a
  Meta Quest 3 inspection app in production at auto-repair shops, owning its AI layer from photo
  grading to the agents that run on the headset, VIN reading and voice. Built the evaluation behind
  its photo grading, measured on real inspections. Built XR Auto Service end to end, including the
  knowledge graph and retrieval behind its repair assistant. Shipped GardenXR to the Meta Horizon
  Store and built an offline voice-to-voice assistant.
- Computer Vision Engineer, ThorMed Innovation, Dallas, Feb 2025 to now. Modeling lead on an
  NIH-funded project to segment the bladder in clinical ultrasound. U-Net encoders pretrained on
  9,204 thyroid and breast ultrasound images reach 96 percent Dice; under 4-bit weight
  quantization they keep 75 to 93 percent Dice, while ImageNet-initialized ones fall to 11 to 71
  percent.
- Teaching Assistant, UT Dallas, Jan 2025 to May 2025. Algorithms and data structures.
- Undergraduate Research Assistant, SODALab, University of Alberta, Dec 2023 to May 2024.
  Survey and simulations of multi-armed bandits with Dr. Xiaoqi Tan.
- Teaching Assistant, University of Alberta, Sep 2023 to May 2024. Algorithms and data structures.
- Undergraduate Researcher, Online Learning, Amii, Apr 2022 to May 2023. Online optimization with
  the primal-dual framework and learning-augmented algorithms.

## Projects

- XR Auto Service: hands-free, step-by-step diagnostics and repair guidance for technicians on a
  headset, at eXRealityAI. https://exreality.ai/xr-auto-service.php
- Smart DVI: AI-guided vehicle inspection with hands-free photo and video capture, voice input, and
  an advisor-ready report, at eXRealityAI. https://exreality.ai/smartdvi.php
- DatDai: question answering over Vietnamese land law, live on Cloud Run, with an amendment graph
  and a citation verifier. https://github.com/HenryVu27/DatDai
- ADHD Coaching Agent: LangGraph ReAct agent with guardrail gates, hybrid retrieval, four-tier
  memory, and an evaluation package. https://github.com/HenryVu27/ADHDAgent
- GardenXR: mixed-reality gardening app for Meta Quest on the Meta Horizon Store.
  https://www.meta.com/experiences/gardenxr/24200709416226235/
- Ultrasound Bladder Segmentation: domain-aligned pretraining and 4-bit quantization for an
  NIH-funded project, with a paper. https://github.com/HenryVu27/ThorMed
- ML Interview Practice: browser-only Python practice for ML coding interviews.
  https://henryvu.io/MLInterviewPractice/
- Agentic Framework for Suspect Detection: LangGraph multi-agent pipeline that flags gaps in
  patient medical records.
  https://github.com/HenryVu27/Suspect-Detection
- StitchKit: embroidery digitizing pipeline for a one-person shop, phone-first, in Vietnamese.
- VoiceBridge: real-time Vietnamese-to-Russian speech translation proof of concept.
  https://github.com/HenryVu27/voice-agent
- EEG Decoding, Modeling Political Sarcasm, Multi-armed Bandits and Online Learning, Polyps and
  Breast Ultrasound Segmentation, A Survey of Geometric Set Cover, and earlier coursework.
